heroSummary: Osceola County observes Rodeo Day on February 20 as a student holiday and teacher non-workday. January 9, March 13, and May 29 are teacher workdays that may become Emergency Make-Up Days; PATHS follows a separate calendar.
seoTitle: Osceola School District Calendar 2025-2026: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Osceola School District 2025-2026 calendar with Aug 11 first day, May 28 last day, Rodeo Day, breaks, emergency make-up days, PDF and ICS.
calendarNotes: The School District of Osceola County starts the 2025-2026 school year for students on Monday, August 11, 2025 and ends the student year on Thursday, May 28, 2026. Thanksgiving student holidays run November 24-28, Winter Break runs December 22-January 2 with classes resuming January 5, and Spring Break runs March 16-20 with classes resuming March 23. The calendar lists January 9, March 13, and May 29 as teacher workdays/student holidays that may be used as emergency make-up days, and notes that the calendar applies to all district schools with the exception of PATHS.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Osceola County school start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Osceola County students is Monday, August 11, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Osceola County in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Thursday, May 28, 2026, which is also the end of the fourth grading period.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Osceola Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 16 through Friday, March 20, 2026. Classes resume Monday, March 23.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Rodeo Day for Osceola Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Rodeo Day is Friday, February 20, 2026. It is listed as a teacher non-workday/student holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: Which 2025-2026 Osceola dates are emergency make-up days?
calendarFaqs.a: The official calendar marks January 9, March 13, and May 29 as teacher workdays/student holidays or emergency make-up days.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2025-2026 Osceola calendar apply to PATHS?
calendarFaqs.a: The official 2025-2026 calendar says it applies to all schools in the district with the exception of PATHS. PATHS families should verify their program calendar separately.
